name: openai
description: GPT models for chat, completion, and embeddings

roleAssignments.note: Use for standalone OpenAI resources (kind: OpenAI)
Use for AI Services resources (kind: AIServices) — preferred for Foundry
Required for both standalone and AIServices patterns

integration.authNote: Use DefaultAzureCredential with get_bearer_token_provider for the OpenAI Python SDK. Assign 'Cognitive Services OpenAI User' role to the managed identity.

bicepWiring.note: Use GlobalStandard SKU by default (works in all regions). Add dependsOn between multiple deployments under same account to avoid conflicts.

sdkInitPattern.python:
from openai import AzureOpenAI
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential, get_bearer_token_provider

credential = DefaultAzureCredential(managed_identity_client_id=os.environ.get('AZURE_CLIENT_ID'))
token_provider = get_bearer_token_provider(credential, 'https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/.default')

client = AzureOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint=os.environ['AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT'],
    azure_ad_token_provider=token_provider,
    api_version=os.environ.get('AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION', '2024-10-21')
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model=os.environ['AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT'],
    messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Hello'}]
)

streamingPattern.description: Use stream=True for chat UIs to get incremental token delivery

healthCheck.python:
# List deployments to validate endpoint + auth
client.models.list()
